purpose: Record deterministic historical file-workflow call counts, apply_patch expected call shapes, and the observational protocol for later source-built and live performance measurements. This fixture does not report measured latency.

measurementPolicy.warmup: Record whether warmup runs occurred and exclude or include them consistently.
measurementPolicy.repetitions: Record raw samples for every repetition; summarize with median and p95 only when enough samples exist.
measurementPolicy.environment: Identify the source build, run, workstation, relay, model, and relevant configuration for each measurement.
measurementPolicy.outcome: Record success or failure for every attempted run.

deterministicUnitAssertions: historical file-workflow and apply_patch expected call shapes
one unmeasured workstation relay-operation acceptance target
absence of measured latency values and latency thresholds
